title: Sebastian and the Smile
author: Isandro Ashgrove
blurb: Theo Nakamura, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
